title: Space Race mission safety and mandatory researched hardware
scope: All 84 human-player programmes. No AI campaigns and no satellite resource yields.
acceptance: Full acceptance remains departure probability multiplied by objective/return probability. Catastrophic and partial outcomes are subsets of unsuccessful stages, not extra independent failure rolls.

severity.failed_departure: 14% catastrophic loss, 40% safe abort, 46% other launch loss. These are conditional shares of the failed-departure branch.
severity.remaining_failed_objective: The partial-results interval ends at the 55th percentile. The remainder is ordinary failure; all noncatastrophic crewed outcomes preserve the crew.
severity.exposure_display: Absolute catastrophic exposure is (1 - departure) * launch catastrophe share + departure * (1 - objective) * objective catastrophe share. Crew exposure omits uncrewed station-launch losses. Paid assurance, funded supports, hardware, flight experience and corrective work affect the actual stage probabilities.

contained_anomaly.draws: One checkpoint midway through each new flight. No draws on menu refresh or report replay. No retroactive checkpoint for flights already in progress before this version.
contained_anomaly.probability: Baseline 10% for deep-space or crewed flights, otherwise 6%, plus half the objective-failure probability; bounded to 2-30%. Conditional on successful departure.
contained_anomaly.delay_days: 30 for deep-space or campaigns lasting at least a year; otherwise 3 for crewed flights and 7 for robotic flights.
contained_anomaly.supplementary_appropriation: One invoice of 2% of mission appropriation, minimum $0.005bn. Available treasury pays it; the remainder becomes existing programme arrears and must be paid before the next departure. It is not a recurring charge.
contained_anomaly.effect: Delay and cost only. The final objective/return draw still determines the outcome, so the full-success estimate has no hidden additional failure probability.

reviews: Paid reviews: safe abort 1 month and 2% mission cost (minimum $0.005bn); partial 3 months / 8%; failure 6 months / 18%; catastrophe 12 months / 30% (minimum $0.025bn for these three). Work advances through weekly appropriations. New attempts pay a fresh mission cost.
casualties: Catastrophes can kill the full mission crew. Only nationally supplied crew are removed from national manpower and charged political losses. An uncrewed station launch cannot kill astronauts who have not boarded. Fatal losses continue to trigger country-named world news.
research_guards: The exact OLV and payload-family requirements are checked in the actual launch effect and shown as separate MET/MISSING entries. A planetary probe-bus demonstration now also requires OLV research. Ground acceptance and initial purchased foreign launch services do not require a domestic orbital launcher. Programme development may run alongside research, but departure may not bypass it.

historical_precedents.example: Gemini VI-A was safely aborted shortly after ignition on 12 December 1965 and launched on 15 December after faults were corrected.
historical_precedents.design_use: A failed launch attempt can preserve the crew and require a shorter funded inspection rather than automatically becoming a fatal accident. The game's month-scale review is campaign balancing, not the actual three-day interval.

historical_precedents.example: Apollo 13's oxygen-tank failure disabled normal electrical and oxygen supplies; the lunar landing was abandoned and contingency operations returned the crew safely.
historical_precedents.design_use: Life support, power and Earth return matter separately from achieving the planned landing. Survival alone does not qualify the abandoned objective. Minor contained incidents in this implementation are separate from severe objective failures.

balance_notice: All probabilities, severity shares, costs and campaign delays are explicit gameplay values, not historical or engineering reliability estimates.
validation: Generated-script AST execution, technology guards, monetary conservation, one-time checkpoints, frozen estimates, crew accounting and native GUI layout. A live HOI4/MP test is still outstanding.
